description: This file provides server-side entry handling for a Remix web application, managing HTTP requests, response headers, and server-side rendering via React streams. It distinguishes between bot and browser requests for rendering optimizations.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main handler for incoming HTTP requests, sets CORS headers, and routes based on user-agent detection.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests using React streaming, resolving to a Response with the rendered HTML stream.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests similarly, using React streaming, and returns a Response with the HTML stream.
